policy: scripts/check_npm_audit.mjs fails if npm audit --omit=dev reports any advisory, if a full npm audit advisory id is absent from this file, or if an id listed here is no longer reported. Critical production issues are not allowlisted.

advisories.reason: braces 3.0.3 is the newest 3.x and is still affected. It is pulled by tailwindcss 3.4.19 (chokidar, micromatch) and by eslint-config-next 15 (fast-glob). Dev and build tooling only, not the production bundle. Clearing it means tailwindcss 4.3.3, a major configuration change. The audit's eslint-config-next fix is a downgrade to 14.2.35, which does not match Next 15.

postcss-selector-parser 6.x has no patched release. The fixed release is 7.1.6. Tailwind CSS 3 depends on ^6.1.2 through postcss-nested. This runs at build time. Clearing it means tailwindcss 4.3.3. A major override to parser 7 was not applied.
